prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: matched 16:9 water-and-ink painting background for a Remotion museum film of Lantingji Xu.
Primary request: Add contemporary visitors to the exact empty garden in input image 1. It is the present day at the same winding stream: the ancient scholars are gone, replaced by modern visitors.
Input image 1 is the fixed empty scenic plate. Input image 2 shows the original ancient gathering solely for scale, placement, style and composition. Do NOT retain any ancient scholar from image 2.
Keep the landscape of image 1 unchanged pixel-aligned as closely as possible: camera, bamboo, central tree and its branches, rocks, stream banks, winding stream, distant mountains, brushwork, warm paper texture, lighting, ochre/sage/stone-green palette. The river must remain completely unobstructed. No new buildings or signs.
Subject: Nine present-day Chinese visitors in five quiet small groups on the dry banks, arranged naturally like visitors observing the same site: an older couple on left midground, a young couple near the center-left bank, one visitor far upper right, and a family of three at right foreground plus one person slightly behind them. Clearly modern attire: short jackets, shirts and T-shirts, jeans or modern trousers, sneakers, two small backpacks, one baseball cap. Restrained denim blue, pale ivory, soft rust colors distinguish modern clothes from ancient robes while fitting the painting. Some look at the stream, one holds a small folded museum leaflet without visible writing, a parent gently points for a child. Calm, reflective, ordinary visitors, not posing for a group photograph.
Style/medium: precisely match the existing meticulous Chinese ink-and-mineral-colour painting, the people painted in the SAME medium, no photographic people pasted into a painting. Natural hands, coherent anatomy, small-scale faces. Soft integration into the original brushwork.
Composition: preserve the landscape and its framing; no people in water, no people or objects across the stream; open upper-central region for later added quotations.
Text: none.
Avoid: ancient robes, long traditional costume, scholar caps, calligraphy, readable signs, logos, mobile-phone closeups, vehicles, architecture, new props, crowds, foreground oversize people, changes to the stream or landscape, ghosting, duplicate limbs.
Output: full opaque matched landscape, 1672x941-like 16:9 horizontal framing.
